verses.he: וַ֭יַּעַן צֹפַ֥ר הַֽנַּעֲמָתִ֗י וַיֹּאמַֽר׃
verses.en: Then answered Zophar the Naamathite, and said:

verses.he: הֲרֹ֣ב דְּ֭בָרִים לֹ֣א יֵעָנֶ֑ה וְאִם־אִ֖ישׁ שְׂפָתַ֣יִם יִצְדָּֽק׃
verses.en: Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be accounted right?

verses.he: בַּ֭דֶּיךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁו וַ֝תִּלְעַ֗ג וְאֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם׃
verses.en: Thy boastings have made men hold their peace, And thou hast mocked, with none to make thee ashamed;

verses.he: וַ֭תֹּאמֶר זַ֣ךְ לִקְחִ֑י וּ֝בַ֗ר הָיִ֥יתִי בְעֵינֶֽיךָ׃
verses.en: And thou hast said: ‘My doctrine is pure, And I am clean in Thine eyes.’

verses.he: וְֽאוּלָ֗ם מִֽי־יִתֵּ֣ן אֱל֣וֹהַּ דַּבֵּ֑ר וְיִפְתַּ֖ח שְׂפָתָ֣יו עִמָּֽךְ׃
verses.en: But oh that God would speak, And open His lips against thee;

verses.he: וְיַגֶּד־לְךָ֨׀ תַּֽעֲלֻמ֣וֹת חָכְמָה֮ כִּֽי־כִפְלַ֪יִם לְֽת֫וּשִׁיָּ֥ה וְדַ֡ע כִּֽי־יַשֶּׁ֥ה לְךָ֥ אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ מֵעֲו‍ֹנֶֽךָ׃
verses.en: And that He would tell thee the secrets of wisdom, That sound wisdom is manifold! Know therefore that God exacteth of thee less than thine iniquity deserveth.

verses.he: הַחֵ֣קֶר אֱל֣וֹהַ תִּמְצָ֑א אִ֤ם עַד־תַּכְלִ֖ית שַׁדַּ֣י תִּמְצָֽא׃
verses.en: Canst thou find out the deep things of God? Canst thou attain unto the purpose of the Almighty?

verses.he: גָּבְהֵ֣י שָׁ֭מַיִם מַה־תִּפְעָ֑ל עֲמֻקָּ֥ה מִ֝שְּׁא֗וֹל מַה־תֵּדָֽע׃
verses.en: It is high as heaven; what canst thou do? Deeper than the nether-world; what canst thou know?

verses.he: אֲרֻכָּ֣ה מֵאֶ֣רֶץ מִדָּ֑הּ וּ֝רְחָבָ֗ה מִנִּי־יָֽם׃
verses.en: The measure thereof is longer than the earth, And broader than the sea.

verses.he: אִם־יַחֲלֹ֥ף וְיַסְגִּ֑יר וְ֝יַקְהִ֗יל וּמִ֣י יְשִׁיבֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.en: If He pass by, and shut up, Or gather in, then who can hinder Him?

verses.he: כִּי־ה֭וּא יָדַ֣ע מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וַיַּרְא־אָ֝֗וֶן וְלֹ֣א יִתְבּוֹנָֽן׃
verses.en: For He knoweth base men; And when He seeth iniquity, will He not then consider it?

verses.he: וְאִ֣ישׁ נָ֭בוּב יִלָּבֵ֑ב וְעַ֥יִר פֶּ֝֗רֶא אָדָ֥ם יִוָּלֵֽד׃
verses.en: But an empty man will get understanding, When a wild ass’s colt is born a man.

verses.he: אִם־אַ֭תָּ֗ה הֲכִינ֣וֹתָ לִבֶּ֑ךָ וּפָרַשְׂתָּ֖ אֵלָ֣יו כַּפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.en: If thou set thy heart aright, And stretch out thy hands toward Him—

verses.he: אִם־אָ֣וֶן בְּ֭יָדְךָ הַרְחִיקֵ֑הוּ וְאַל־תַּשְׁכֵּ֖ן בְּאֹהָלֶ֣יךָ עַוְלָֽה׃
verses.en: If iniquity be in thy hand, put it far away, And let not unrighteousness dwell in thy tents—

verses.he: כִּי־אָ֤ז׀ תִּשָּׂ֣א פָנֶ֣יךָ מִמּ֑וּם וְהָיִ֥יתָ מֻ֝צָ֗ק וְלֹ֣א תִירָֽא׃
verses.en: Surely then shalt thou lift up thy face without spot; Yea, thou shalt be stedfast, and shalt not fear;

verses.he: כִּי־אַ֭תָּה עָמָ֣ל תִּשְׁכָּ֑ח כְּמַ֖יִם עָבְר֣וּ תִזְכֹּֽר׃
verses.en: For thou shalt forget thy misery; Thou shalt remember it as waters that are passed away;

verses.he: וּֽ֭מִצָּהֳרַיִם יָק֣וּם חָ֑לֶד תָּ֝עֻ֗פָה כַּבֹּ֥קֶר תִּהְיֶֽה׃
verses.en: And thy life shall be clearer than the noonday; Though there be darkness, it shall be as the morning.

verses.he: וּֽ֭בָטַחְתָּ כִּי־יֵ֣שׁ תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝חָפַרְתָּ֗ לָבֶ֥טַח תִּשְׁכָּֽב׃
verses.en: And thou shalt be secure, because there is hope; Yea, thou shalt look about thee, and shalt take thy rest in safety.

verses.he: וְֽ֭רָבַצְתָּ וְאֵ֣ין מַחֲרִ֑יד וְחִלּ֖וּ פָנֶ֣יךָ רַבִּֽים׃
verses.en: Also thou shalt lie down, and none shall make thee afraid; Yea, many shall make suit unto thee.

verses.he: וְעֵינֵ֥י רְשָׁעִ֗ים תִּ֫כְלֶ֥ינָה וּ֭מָנוֹס אָבַ֣ד מִנְהֶ֑ם וְ֝תִקְוָתָ֗ם מַֽפַּח־נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.en: But the eyes of the wicked shall fail, And they shall have no way to flee, And their hope shall be the drooping of the soul.
